### What is UNO?

UNO is a multiplayer simulation package in R. It simulates all aspects of a standard UNO game including:

-   Shuffling and dealing cards

-   Turn-based game logic with direction changes

-   Full support for action cards (Skip, Reverse, +2, Wild, Wild Draw 4)

-   Automatic winner detection and scoring

```{r}
library(uno)

```

### Installation

```{r}
# If not already installed
install.packages("devtools")

# Install from GitHub (replace with your actual repo)
devtools::install_github("MonashARP/game-package-kookaburras", subdir = "uno")

```
